## Appendix 3. Code excerpts of the example study

The excerpts below show, one stage at a time, how the elements that the Results describe are written in the Studyflow file. The complete diagrams and run records are in the supplementary repository (see Data availability).

### Design: enrollment and allocation

```{#lst-design .yaml lst-cap="The Stage 1 excerpt of the diagram as text, abridged. It includes the start event with its reference to the consent document, the eligibility gateway with its inclusion criterion and the executable condition of its 'yes' path, and the allocation gateway with its allocation algorithm and ratio. The other path of each gateway (to 'Excluded' and to the control group) is its default path, which the diagram draws with a short slash across its start; it is not shown."}
Enroll:
  type: StartEvent
  name: Enrolled and consented
  consentFormUri: https://behaverse.org/protocols/example-study/consent.md

Eligibility_Gateway:
  type: ExclusiveGateway
  name: Understood the instructions?
  default: $Flow_Excluded
  extensions:
    cognitive:EligibilityGateway:
      inclusionCriteria:
        - Comprehension check answered as instructed

Flow_Eligible:
  name: yes (n={reached})
  condition: contains(upper case(Screening), "READY") and not(contains(upper case(Screening), "NOT"))
  source: $Eligibility_Gateway
  target: $Randomize

Randomize:
  type: ExclusiveGateway
  name: Which group? (n={reached})
  default: $Flow_Arm_Standard
  extensions:
    cognitive:RandomGateway:
      algorithm: block
      allocationRatio: "1:1"
```

```{=latex}
% Listing 2 is long: it starts on a new page, so that it runs over two pages instead of three
\newpage
```

### Run: tasks and trial exchanges

```{#lst-tasks .yaml lst-cap="The Stage 2 excerpt of the diagram as text, abridged. It includes the prompt with the strategy instruction and the two tasks of session 1 of the treatment group, each with the software and the agent that it names and the dataset that it writes its trials to. It ends with the session's exit rule."}
Prompt_Flanker_Strategy:
  type: DataObjectReference
  name: Flanker prompt, strategy
  extensions:
    agentic:Prompt:
      template: |
        You are taking a computerised test one trial at a time. Each message is one trial and lists the answers it
        accepts under ResponseOptions; answer with one of them, copied exactly and with nothing else. Any other reply
        is a lost trial.

        In this task a row of five arrows appears. Answer with the direction the middle arrow points, Left or Right,
        whatever the direction of the arrows around it.

        Strategy: look only at the middle arrow. The arrows around it never tell you the answer, so do not let them
        pull you to their side.
      delivery: once

S1_Strategy_Flanker:
  type: ChoreographyTask
  name: Flanker task
  participant: $Pool_Agent
  extensions:
    cognitive:CognitiveTask:
      platform: jspsych
      implementation: jspsych://html-keyboard-response@8
  inputs:
    In_S1_Strategy_Flanker_0:
      source: $Prompt_Flanker_Strategy

    In_S1_Strategy_Flanker_1:
      source: $Protocol_Flanker

    In_S1_Strategy_Flanker_2:
      source: $Task_Settings
  outputs:
    Out_S1_Strategy_Flanker_Trials:
      target: $Dataset_Trials

S1_Strategy_Simon:
  type: ChoreographyTask
  name: Simon task
  participant: $Pool_Agent
  extensions:
    behaverse:Task:
      implementation: behaverse://assessment-unity@26.11
      instrument: WO
      timeline: Simon_Practice_Test
  outputs:
    Out_S1_Strategy_Simon_Trials:
      target: $Dataset_Trials

Exit_S1_Strategy:
  type: BoundaryEvent
  condition: unanswered > max_unanswered
  attachedTo: $S1_Strategy
```

### Run: changing the agent

```{#lst-swap .diff lst-cap="Who takes the study is stated in one place, the agent's pool. The variant for Gemma 4 E4B differs from the example study (Gemma 4 E2B) only in the two lines shown, the pool's name and the model it names. In this diff, lines that start with a minus sign appear only in the example study, and lines that start with a plus sign only in the variant. The variant for d1 3B changes the same two lines, and the simulated variant replaces the model with the response probabilities of the simulated agent (not shown)."}
--- example_study.studyflow.yaml
+++ example_study-gemma4-e4b.studyflow.yaml
@@ -33,6 +33,6 @@
     Pool_Agent:
-      name: "Agent: Gemma 4 E2B"
+      name: "Agent: Gemma 4 E4B"
       extensions:
         studyflow:Actor:
           actorType: llm
-          implementation: ollama://gemma4:e2b-mlx
+          implementation: ollama://gemma4:e4b
```

### Analyze: the registered rule

```{#lst-analysis .yaml lst-cap="The Stage 3 excerpt of the diagram as text, abridged. It includes the decision rules, the t-test, which calls one library function with its arguments, and the 'yes' path of the decision gateway, whose condition reads the result of the t-test and the alpha of the decision rules."}
Decision_Rules:
  type: DataObjectReference
  name: Decision rules
  extensions:
    studyflow:Parameters:
      values:
        alpha: 0.05
        min_completed: 20

Effect_Test:
  type: ServiceTask
  name: One-sided Welch t test
  additionalArguments:
    a: "{standard.effect}"
    b: "{strategy.effect}"
    equal_var: false
    alternative: greater
    nan_policy: omit
  implementation: python://scipy.stats.ttest_ind
  outputs:
    Out_Effect_Test:
      target: $flanker_test

Flow_Yes:
  name: "yes"
  condition: flanker_test.statistic > 0 and flanker_test.pvalue < alpha
  source: $Decision
  target: $Supported
```

### Report: comparing the plan and the run

```{#lst-diff .diff lst-cap="The registered and the executed diagram compared line by line (excerpt, with the run's records abridged and the fingerprint, the commit, and the numbers shortened). The file is that of the simulated run with an effect built into the treatment group (@tbl-planted). Every changed line, marked with a plus sign, was added by the run. These lines hold the run's record with the protocol's fingerprint, a note on each element the run reached, the counts, including the claim statement reached, and the computed values. No line of the protocol changed, so there is no deviation, and the validator confirms this by recomputing the fingerprint."}
--- planted.studyflow.yaml (registered)
+++ planted.studyflow.yaml (after execution)
@@ ... @@
       version: "3.0"
+    prov:Activity:
+      - {action: executed, run: run-planted, seed: 42, plan: sha256:50de832084c3...}
@@ ... @@
       consentFormUri: https://behaverse.org/protocols/example-study/consent.md
+      extensions:
+        prov:Activity:
+          - {action: executed, run: run-planted, commit: 1f9ac63}
@@ ... @@
+state:
+  _meta:
+    reached:
+      Enroll: 48
+      Completed: 48
+      Supported: 1
+  Analysis:
+    n_completed: 48
+    flanker_test: {statistic: 4.80, pvalue: 0.00002, df: 32.7}
```
